rivals.name: Zendesk
rivals.why: The buyer's larger, more department-scale option when support has outgrown Help Scout's simplicity and needs more customization, channels, and reporting.

rivals.name: Intercom
rivals.why: The AI-first, product-led alternative a B2C/SaaS buyer compares against when they want conversational support, proactive engagement, and a Fin/Copilot-style AI agent alongside the inbox.

rivals.name: Front
rivals.why: The closest match to Help Scout's collaborative shared-inbox feel, so teams comparing 'which inbox tool' rather than 'which helpdesk platform' land here first.

rivals.name: Gmail (shared inbox via labels/delegation) or Hiver on top of Gmail
rivals.why: The status quo many small support teams are actually running today — a Gmail/Google Workspace shared mailbox with manual labels and delegation — before they decide a dedicated tool like Help Scout is worth paying for.
